route: Artist entry visa (General Security, artists department)

permit.applies: The engaging firm or the convener applies to General Security's artists department, stating the date and length of the work and the artist's pay; an artistic enterprise must be constituted with General Security first.
permit.first: The original contract endorsed in advance by the Unified Mutual Fund for Artists, and payment of 10 % of the contract value to the Ministry of Finance for the Fund; a guarantee engagement and a financial guarantee of LBP 2,000,000 per artist.

fees.what: Artist visa, each artist each month, show venue class A (3 stars or more)
Artist visa, each artist each month, show venue class B (1 or 2 stars)
Optional immediate processing of an artists' department request
Financial guarantee per artist (a deposit, not a fee)

permit.union: The original contract must first be endorsed by the Unified Mutual Fund for Artists (Law No. 56 of 2008 on the Regulation of Artistic Professions, art. 16), with 10 % of its value paid for the Fund.
permit.eligibility: A person that performs professionally in fine arts, or on a superior level in arts and craft, or any applied art (such as music, theater, cinema, dance, televised animation, radio, circuses, shows, imitations, advertisements, paintings, drawings, photograph, tattoo, engraving, sculptures, and decorations).

sources.title: General Security, Artistic Enterprises
sources.said: The artists that wish to work in Lebanon, have to have an entry visa in hand that has been delivered by the general security – artist department. The interested party has to apply for this visa, whether it’s the firm or the convener, they must specify the date and duration of work, as well as the remuneration of the artist. … A person that performs professionally in fine arts, or on a superior level in arts and craft, or any applied art (such as music, theater, cinema, dance, televised animation, radio, circuses, shows, imitations, advertisements, paintings, drawings, photograph, tattoo, engraving, sculptures, and decorations). … A financial guarantee of 2,000,000 L.B.P for each artist. … The records will be reviewed, before granting the visa in a 2 day period. … The artists and models are granted an entry visa equivalent to the execution period mentioned in the contract (30 days). The latter is renewable every month, upon agreement of both parties. A 3 months visa can be granted according to the contract if the fees have been paid. … International orchestras groups, ballet dancers, sport show artists, water-skiing artists, figure skating artists, theater, are not considered artists and are exempted from artist taxes. They are granted a touristic visa

sources.title: General Security, Entry visa of an artist to touristic enterprises
sources.said: 15.000.000 L.B.P – every month for each artist if the location of the show is class B (1 or 2 stars). … 30.000.000 L.B.P – every month for each artist if the location of the show is class A (3 stars or more). … A receipt showing that a 10% fee has been paid to the Artists’ Mutual Fund

sources.title: General Security, Amendment of Required Documents for Obtaining an Artist Visa
sources.said: The original contract signed with the foreign artist must be presented in advance to the Unified Mutual Fund for Artists, and the official endorsement stamp of the Fund must be obtained on the contract before proceeding with any other procedures. … A fee of 10% of the contract value must be paid to the Ministry of Finance in favor of the Unified Mutual Fund for Artists

sources.title: General Security, Work Permit for Foreign Artists and Musicians
sources.said: First Category 30.000.000 L.L. Second Category 15.000.000 L.L.

sources.title: General Security, Residency of foreign artists
sources.said: Foreign artists, who do not work in Nightclubs, can obtain temporary residency for a period of six months at once, on the condition that: … Possession of a valid employment contract for the duration of residence.

sources.title: General Security, Fees for immediate requests for artists
sources.said: The above-mentioned requests can be applied for at the department of artists with an extra amount of 4,900,000 L.L. to be paid in order to process them immediately. … Request for a new residence permit or its renewal, attached with an entry/exit form request (Immediately).

note: The 10 % of contract value is a levy for the artists' fund, besides the fees. The monthly fee by venue class (page 48) matches the two categories on the 'Work Permit for Foreign Artists and Musicians' page (30 and 15 million); page 40 still shows older monthly fees of LBP 350,000 and 700,000, superseded. The entry visa runs for the contract's execution period, renewable monthly, or three months if the fees are paid; the six months is the temporary residency at once. Artists who don't work in nightclubs may get temporary residency for six months at a time on a valid contract, with double service fees (renewal is among the requests the department processes). International orchestras, ballet, theatre groups and similar aren't counted as 'artists' and enter on a tourist visa, and singers filming a video clip get an entry visa from the director general, so a theatre company's actors may not need the artist visa; the game models the artist route. Advertisement actors and models may work at most six months without a break.
